$comment: p15-oracle-093: e2e scripts 12-22 of MQ-e2e (`ls scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.py scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.sh`, sorted, 66), each converted to a case of this suite or excluded with a reason (p15-oracle.md section 5, item 4). The scripts stay; each case's first step names its script. `bug` is the commit whose behavior the case checks and `parent` its parent, where the case fails. oracle.py does not run `_` files. The batches of p15-oracle-092 and 094-097 hold the other scripts; the suite's coverage.json, written from all six, counts a script once it is converted or excluded here.

scripts/cmux-next/color-transition-e2e.p.excluded: samples the presented backdrop and terminal colors as fast as the socket answers and checks recorded window pixels for blend steps (OKLab distance per frame, retarget, Liquid Glass): oracle runs have animations off (section 3B), snapshot-v1 has no theme or color facet, and frame smoothness is the motion-on switch arm and perf-lead benches, not a state checkpoint

scripts/cmux-next/default-theme-e2e.py.excluded: asserts the applied Ghostty background and every window's chrome color (debug.themes) after debug.appearance flips the app's appearance: snapshot-v1 has no theme or appearance facet, and a cli `app call debug.themes` step's expect compares the whole reply (window numbers, edge-fade geometry); converts when a themes facet lands

scripts/cmux-next/dock-split-pane-e2e.py.fails_at: dock: column.dock answers move-tab-to-column failed, so expect ok fails

scripts/cmux-next/drop-ring-e2e.py.excluded: drags a tab with real mouse events (debug.mouse drag) and samples the drop overlay every 50 ms for 4 s (debug.drop_highlight): case-v1 has no pointer step, no snapshot facet reads the drop ring, and a timed sample series is not a checkpoint

scripts/cmux-next/exception-report-e2e.p.excluded: ends the app process on purpose (an NSException, or a crash path that blocks) and checks the next launch's crash notice and report file: allow_crashes kinds are child processes only (no app kind), the app driver has no restart yet (p15-oracle-023, p15-oracle-188), and no facet reads the launch notice

scripts/cmux-next/ext-e2e.py.excluded: store mode downloads real Chrome Web Store extensions (oracle cases are offline, section 3D); api mode stages unpacked extensions into a fresh Chromium profile with a DevTools port and drives popups through CDP: no case-v1 fixture installs extensions and no facet reads the conformance collector

scripts/cmux-next/file-pages-e2e.py.excluded: edits a markdown and a code page through debug.page input, saves with Cmd-S and checks the exact bytes on disk, a conflict banner's text and a 10 MB file: driver_app builds no file fixture (fixture.repo, $CASE_ROOT paths), case-v1 has no page-input step, and no facet reads file bytes or page text

scripts/cmux-next/file-pages-r96-e2e.py.fails_at: directory-diff: palette.openDirectoryDiffViewer from the CLI opens the picker and answers ok, so expect error control.unavailable fails
